author: Bilal
title: Control Structures
notes: COMP101 Control Structures (Lecture 3). Real algorithms: Trial Division Primality Test, Euclidean GCD, Repeated Division Binary Conversion, Linear Search. Patterns: Accumulator, Early-Exit Loop, Sentinel-Controlled Loop. Element Traversal; enumerate() builtin+DataType; not in.

entity_types.name: Algorithm
entity_types.definition: A programming algorithm taught during the lecture

entity_types.name: ConceptCarrier
entity_types.definition: Python surface that can realize or carry curriculum concepts (language constructs, operators, builtins, data types). Organizational superclass used as domain/range of realization and algorithm-construct properties.

entity_types.name: Pattern
entity_types.definition: A reusable pedagogical programming pattern taught in this lecture (e.g. accumulator during iteration).

relations.name: acceptedBy
relations.definition: Inverse of accepts_type.

relations.name: acceptsType
relations.definition: A function accepts this data type as input.

relations.name: constructUsedBy
relations.definition: Inverse of usesConstruct: this ConceptCarrier is employed by the object Algorithm. A-Box may assert only usesConstruct; reasoners can infer this direction.

relations.name: contrastsWith
relations.definition: Relates two concepts that represent alternative, opposite, or commonly confused ideas.

relations.name: dependsOn
relations.definition: Indicates that understanding one educational entity requires prior understanding of another.

relations.name: hasMethods
relations.definition: Inverse of method_of.

relations.name: implementedBy
relations.definition: Concept is realized/expressed by this ConceptCarrier (language construct, operator, builtin, or data type). Inverse of implementsConcept. Domain is Concept only (not Algorithm).

relations.name: implementsConcept
relations.definition: Inverse of implementedBy: a ConceptCarrier realizes or expresses this Concept. A-Box may assert only implementedBy; reasoners can infer this direction.

relations.name: isProducedBy
relations.definition: Inverse of produces_type.

relations.name: isRequiredBy
relations.definition: Inverse of depends_on.

relations.name: isThrownBy
relations.definition: Inverse of throws_error.

relations.name: isUsedBy
relations.definition: Inverse of uses_concept.

relations.name: methodOf
relations.definition: This method belongs to a data type.

relations.name: operatedOnBy
relations.definition: Inverse of operatesOnType.

relations.name: operatesOnType
relations.definition: Subject works on / iterates using values of the object DataType. Used for Operators and for pedagogical Concepts such as Index Traversal or Element Traversal.

relations.name: producesType
relations.definition: Returns this data type.

relations.name: taughtIn
relations.definition: Associates an ontology entity with the lecture in which it is introduced or explicitly taught.

relations.name: teaches
relations.definition: Inverse of taught_in.

relations.name: throwsError
relations.definition: Associates a language construct, function, method, or concept with an error that may result from its incorrect use.

relations.name: usesConcept
relations.definition: Indicates that an entity relies on or makes use of a programming concept.

relations.name: usesConstruct
relations.definition: Algorithm is coded with / employs this ConceptCarrier (language construct, operator, builtin, or data type). Distinct from implementedBy (Concept → carrier realization). Inverse of constructUsedBy.
